# Golden Paws Pet Resort and Spa

> A family-owned luxury pet care facility in New Jersey offering comprehensive boarding, daycare, grooming, and training services for dogs, cats, puppies, kittens, and small animals.

Golden Paws operates a 12,000 sq ft facility with multiple locations across New Jersey including Robbinsville, Hamilton, Trenton, and the Princeton area. The resort specializes in customized pet care packages with amenities like Hydro-Surge grooming services and specialized programs such as Clever Canines Daycare and As Good As Gold training.

## Core Services

- [Dog Lodging](https://www.goldenpawspetresort.com/dog-lodging): Luxury dog boarding with spacious suites in Robbinsville, NJ
- [Cat Lodging](https://www.goldenpawspetresort.com/cat-lodging): Premium cat boarding with Kitty Komfort and TLC packages
- [Doggie Daycare](https://www.goldenpawspetresort.com/doggie-daycare): Off-leash dog daycare with supervised playgroups in Robbinsville
- [Grooming & Spa](https://www.goldenpawspetresort.com/grooming-spa): Full-service pet grooming and spa with Hydro-Surge services
- [Small Animal Lodging](https://www.goldenpawspetresort.com/small-animal-lodging): Small animal boarding for rabbits, guinea pigs, and similar pets

## Specialized Programs

- [Just for Puppies](https://www.goldenpawspetresort.com/just-for-puppies): Specialized puppy boarding, daycare, and training programs
- [Just for Kittens](https://www.goldenpawspetresort.com/just-for-kittens): Specialized kitten boarding and care packages
- [Dog Training](https://www.goldenpawspetresort.com/dog-training): Dog training programs including As Good As Gold and Doggie Day School
